name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down with your knees aligned with the machine pivot and the roller against your lower calves, just above your heels.
Take the handles and keep your hips against the pad.
Flex your knees smoothly to curl the roller up toward your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings firmly at the top.
Lower the pad slowly back toward full leg extension without letting the weight stack drop abruptly.
tips: Keep your hips glued to the pad instead of lifting your glutes up as you curl the weight.
Move through a full controlled range rather than swinging the pad up with momentum.
